note: The GM's map of the red line: every beat of the root story and how much of it has reached players. hidden = told nowhere; hinted = a careful reader could suspect; revealed = stated in shipped text. hinted/revealed beats point at the exact texts that do the telling; the build fails a beat whose pointers do not hold. This file is GM material — fetched by the wiki's Game Master view like RED_LINE.md, never baked into player data (lore.json carries counts only).

beats.title: The Keeping — what is told aloud holds its shape
The four stages — Bright, Faded, Habit, Quiet
Soulstones are the last hard piece of a long forgetting
Signe lost Emil to her own silence; the fires are her apology
Not everyone who dies wakes in Nangijala
The masks are attempts at one particular face
beats.notes: Ship only: the masks are alike, made not worn, and always smiling. Never say whose face or why it smiles.

beats.title: The hole under the mountain was a person — one of the best
beats.notes: Ship: it is new, it was probably a person, it is hungry not hateful. Never: who. Also hinted at the empty chair in the muster hall (the_long_table): everyone agrees whoever sat there was very good to the frightened, and then changes the subject. Never name them.

beats.title: When someone goes on, the grief of the left-behind goes missing
beats.notes: The phenomenon is public and disturbing. Its cause is B9 and stays hidden.

beats.title: Going on is weight-bearing: the goer carries out every grief held for them
beats.notes: The gentlest truth in the cosmology, experienced from below as theft. Spend late; it re-colours every B8 scene.

beats.title: Signe may still exist, at Habit, tending a fire that is not there
Sigrun released her own husband and wears his stone in her hammer
beats.notes: His NAME (Stig) stays unspoken in shipped text — she has not said it since, and printing it wastes her scene.

beats.title: The hole is Valter, the first meeting-man
beats.notes: Identity chain step 1. Never spend two identity beats in the same season.

beats.title: He is waiting for his wife, who never woke
She never woke because she is still alive
beats.notes: Identity chain step 3 — the cruelest sentence in the root. The endgame begins the day she dies.

beats.title: The masks smile because in every shared memory of her, she was smiling
beats.notes: Resolves B6. Spend only with or after B13.

beats.title: Something other than the hole also takes memory
beats.notes: Nightmare gallops where sleep is thin and the dreams do not survive the night. Ship only the observation and the unease of the people who measure such things. NEVER connect it to the hole, and never explain it. Held open deliberately: it is the one loose thread that lets the cave's nature be re-read later without retconning anything.
